Name: Generic Extract
Description: Pulls available-domains, clients, posture-stats, completeness, and audit into raw CSV/JSON. Must run before Flatten Extract - that step reads its output.

Name: Flatten Extract
Description: Unwraps nested JSON in audit.csv and clients.csv (produced by Generic Extract) into flat, Power BI-ready tables. Requires Generic Extract to have run first.

Name: Certifications
Description: Pulls Tier Zero / privilege-zone certification status (Pending, Auto, Manual, Revoked) for every object.

Name: Certification Selectors
Description: Enriches certifications.csv with the selector rule(s) that placed each object into its tag. Requires Certifications to have run first.

Name: Findings
Description: Pulls attack path finding counts and detail (ASREPRoasting, Kerberoasting, T0GenericAll, etc.) per environment.

Name: Posture History
Description: Pulls posture history and stats (exposure trend, group/session completeness) per environment. Possible overlap with the posture-history-*.csv files Generic Extract also produces - confirm which one the dashboard actually uses.

Name: Panels (Data Quality / Tier Zero / Trends)
Description: Pulls data quality stats, finding trends, and Tier Zero composition in a single pass.

Name: Collector Health
Description: Pulls collector/client status - last check-in, schedule, job success - per registered collector.

Name: Tenant Info
Description: Pulls tenant host, BHE version, API version, and logged-in user for the dashboard footer bar.
